name: Deploy Live

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Vite site
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to live repository
        env:
          DEPLOY_REPO_LIVE: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_REPO_LIVE }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git clone "https://x-access-token:${DEPLOY_REPO_LIVE}@github.com/NateNeuhaus/website--financial--snapshot.git" deploy

          rm -rf deploy/*
          rm -rf deploy/.[!.]* deploy/..?* 2>/dev/null || true

          cp -R dist/. deploy/

          cd deploy

          git add -A
          git commit -m "Deploy Vite site" || echo "No changes to deploy"
          git push origin main
